articles.title: White hats rescue $500K in NFTs after Flooring exploit
articles.snippet: CoinGecko and NFT Price Floor data show NFT market cap has cooled since April, while CryptoPunks and BAYC remain top collections by value.

articles.title: Bored Ape Maker Yuga Labs Rescues Dozens of Ethereum NFTs From Exploit
articles.snippet: The Bored Ape Yacht Club creator now holds more than 60 rescued NFTs in its custody as it works to return them to their rightful owners.
